evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Vision-language models (VLMs) grasp the overall content of an image but often miss the fine details a question hinges on, such as a small object in a large photo or a number in a dense infographic.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across five backbones, SEE improves every small-object benchmark by 2.3-13.1 points and outperforms five training-free baselines on small objects.
